title: 第十一章 暗流第十二章 排骨和烟头
lines: 工商局的人走后的第二天，沈南枝做了一件事。
她去了一趟中山路。
不是去找白若溪吵架，是去看她的店。做生意的人得知道对手在干什么，不能光坐在家里等。
中山路是京海市最繁华的商业街，两边全是铺子，卖衣服的、卖鞋的、卖家电的、卖吃的，一家挨一家。路上人多，自行车多，公共汽车多，喇叭声和叫卖声混在一起，吵得人脑仁疼。
白若溪的“若溪饰品”在中山路中段，挨着京海第一百货大楼。门面比沈南枝的店大一倍还多，装修也气派，玻璃橱窗里摆着几个模特，脖子上戴着亮闪闪的饰品，橱窗上方挂着一个大招牌，白底红字，晚上应该会亮灯。
沈南枝在马路对面站了一会儿，看了看进店的人数。下午三点多，不算高峰期，但店里一直有人进进出出，生意不能说火爆，但也不差。
她过了马路，推门进去。
店里灯光很亮，货柜摆得整整齐齐，饰品按颜色和材质分类，每件下面都贴着价格标签。收银台后面站着一个年轻姑娘，二十出头，扎着马尾，穿着统一的粉色围裙，看见沈南枝进来，笑着说了一句“欢迎光临”。
沈南枝冲她点了下头，开始在店里转。
货品比她预想的好。白若溪这次没再搞那些廉价的塑料货，进的都是广州来的中档产品，款式偏港风，价格在五块到二十块之间。有几款耳环和项链设计不错，做工也过得去，放在中山路这个地段，确实有竞争力。
但她注意到一个问题——白若溪的货品没有自己的特色。好看是好看，但你在别的店也能买到差不多的。广州来的货，又不是独家代理，谁都能进。
这意味着白若溪没有核心竞争力。她的生意完全依赖于地段和价格，一旦旁边开一家同样地段、同样价格但更有特色的店，她就会很难受。
沈南枝在店里待了不到五分钟，正准备走，白若溪从后面的小房间出来了。
她穿着一件白色衬衫，下面是一条黑色长裤，头发盘起来，露出脖子和耳朵，耳朵上戴着一对珍珠耳钉，看着干练了不少。看见沈南枝，她愣了一下，然后笑了。
“南枝？你怎么来了？”
“路过，进来看看。”沈南枝说。
“觉得怎么样？”白若溪走过来，跟她并排站在货柜前，语气像在跟老朋友聊天，“我这批货是从广州进的，找了好几个厂子才选出来的。”
“还行。”
“只是还行？”白若溪笑了一下，“南枝，你这人还是这么不给人面子。”
沈南枝没接话，往门口走。
白若溪跟上来，压低声音说：“昨天工商局的人去找你了？”
沈南枝停下来，看着她。
白若溪的表情很自然，眼神也很真诚，好像真的在关心她似的。
“你怎么知道的？”沈南枝问。
“京海就这么大，做生意的人多了，消息传得快。”白若溪叹了口气，“南枝，我跟你说句实话，你那个店在城西，地方偏，生意肯定不如中山路好。你要是愿意，我可以帮你把货放在我这里卖，五五分账，怎么样？”
沈南枝看着她，差点笑出来。
工商局的人昨天刚走，她今天就来说这个。五五分账，说得好像多慷慨似的，实际上就是想拿她的设计和产品去填自己的店。沈南枝的货放在“若溪饰品”里卖，顾客买了觉得好，记住的是“若溪饰品”的牌子，不是“南枝手作”。
这算盘打得够精的。
“不用了。”沈南枝说，推门出去了。
白若溪在身后喊了一句：“你想通了随时来找我啊！”
沈南枝没回头。
走出中山路，她在路边买了一根冰棍，一边吃一边走。冰棍是白糖的，三分钱一根，甜得发腻，但天热，吃着舒服。
她脑子里在盘算一件事。
白若溪在京海有关系——那个当科长的朋友。工商局的人来得那么快，举报信刚递就上门了，说不定跟那个人有关系。
她得查清楚。
回到店里，桂姨正在给一个顾客介绍产品。珠珠坐在柜台后面，手里拿着沈南枝给她的一串旧项链在拆，拆下来的珠子按颜色分好，红的放一堆，蓝的放一堆，黄的放一堆，分得仔仔细细的。
“妈！”看见沈南枝进来，珠珠把珠子放下，跑过来抱她的腿，“你去哪了？我想你了。”
“去逛了逛。”沈南枝摸了摸她的头，从口袋里掏出剩下的半根冰棍，已经化了一半，糖水顺着包装纸往下滴，“吃不吃？”
珠珠接过去，咬了一口包装纸，吸里面的糖水，吸得滋滋响。
content_en:
The day after the people from the Industrial and Commercial Bureau left, Shen Nanzhi did something.
She went to Zhongshan Road.
He wasn't going to quarrel with Bai Ruoxi, he was going to see her shop. People who do business need to know what their opponents are doing and cannot just sit at home and wait.
Zhongshan Road is the most prosperous commercial street in Jinghai City. There are shops on both sides, selling clothes, shoes, electrical appliances, and food, one after another. There are many people, bicycles and buses on the road. The sound of horns and shouts are mixed together, making people's brains hurt.
Bai Ruoxi's "Ruoxi Jewelry" is located in the middle of Zhongshan Road, next to the Jinghai First Department Store. The storefront is more than twice the size of Shen Nanzhi's store, and the decoration is also elegant. There are several models in the glass display window, wearing shiny jewelry around their necks. There is a large signboard with red letters on a white background hanging above the display window. It should be lit up at night.
Shen Nanzhi stood across the road for a while and looked at the number of people entering the store. It was around three o'clock in the afternoon, not a peak period, but there were people coming in and out of the store all the time. The business couldn't be said to be hot, but it wasn't bad either.
She crossed the street and opened the door.
The lights in the store are bright, the shelves are neatly arranged, the accessories are classified by color and material, and there is a price tag underneath each piece. Standing behind the cashier was a young girl in her early twenties, with a ponytail and a uniform pink apron. When she saw Shen Nanzhi coming in, she smiled and said "Welcome."
Shen Nanzhi nodded to her and started walking around the store.
The goods were better than she expected. Bai Ruoxi didn't buy those cheap plastic products this time. She only bought mid-range products from Guangzhou. The styles were more Hong Kong-style and the prices ranged from five yuan to twenty yuan. There are several earrings and necklaces with good designs and decent workmanship. They are indeed competitive in this area of ​​Zhongshan Road.
But she noticed a problem - Bai Ruoxi's products did not have their own characteristics. It looks good, but you can buy similar ones in other stores. Products from Guangzhou are not exclusive agents, anyone can buy them.
This means that Bai Ruoxi has no core competitiveness. Her business depends entirely on location and price. Once a store with the same location and the same price but with more features opens next to her, she will feel uncomfortable.
Shen Nanzhi stayed in the store for less than five minutes and was about to leave when Bai Ruoxi came out of the small room at the back.
She was wearing a white shirt and a pair of black trousers. Her hair was tied up, exposing her neck and ears. She wore a pair of pearl earrings on her ears, which made her look much more capable. Seeing Shen Nanzhi, she was stunned for a moment, and then smiled.
"Nanzhi? Why are you here?"
"Passing by, come in and take a look." Shen Nanzhi said.
"What do you think?" Bai Ruoxi came over and stood side by side with her in front of the container, her tone was like chatting with an old friend, "I imported this batch of goods from Guangzhou, and I searched for several factories before selecting them."
"It's okay."
"It's just okay?" Bai Ruoxi smiled, "Nanzhi, you are still so disrespectful to others."
Shen Nanzhi didn't answer and walked to the door.
Bai Ruoxi followed up and lowered her voice and said, "Did people from the Industrial and Commercial Bureau look for you yesterday?"
Shen Nanzhi stopped and looked at her.
Bai Ruoxi's expression was natural and her eyes were sincere, as if she really cared about her.
"How did you know?" Shen Nanzhi asked.
"Jinghai is so big, there are many people doing business, and news spreads quickly." Bai Ruoxi sighed, "Nanzhi, let me tell you the truth, your store is in the west of the city, in a remote location, and the business is definitely not as good as Zhongshan Road. If you are willing, I can help you sell the goods here, and we will split the money 50-50, how about it?"
Shen Nanzhi looked at her and almost laughed.
The people from the Industrial and Commercial Bureau just left yesterday, and she will talk about this today. The 50-50 split seems very generous, but in fact, she just wants to use her designs and products to fill her own store. Shen Nanzhi's goods are sold in "Ruoxi Jewelry". Customers feel good about it after buying it. What they remember is the brand of "Ruoxi Jewelry", not "Nanzhi Handmade".
This calculation is quite precise.
"No need." Shen Nanzhi said, opened the door and went out.
Bai Ruoxi shouted from behind: "You can come to me anytime when you have figured it out!"
Shen Nanzhi didn't look back.
Walking out of Zhongshan Road, she bought a popsicle on the roadside and ate it while walking. The popsicles are made of white sugar and cost three cents each. They are so sweet that they are cloying, but it is hot and comfortable to eat.
She was thinking about something in her mind.
Bai Ruoxi has connections in Jinghai—that friend who is the section chief. The people from the Industrial and Commercial Bureau came so quickly, and they came to the door just as the report letter was delivered. Maybe they were related to that person.
She had to find out.
Back in the store, Aunt Gui was introducing products to a customer. Zhuzhu was sitting behind the counter, holding an old necklace Shen Nanzhi gave her and taking it apart in her hand. The removed beads were sorted according to color, with red ones in one pile, blue ones in one pile, and yellow ones in one pile. They were sorted carefully.
"Mom!" Seeing Shen Nanzhi come in, Zhuzhu put Zhuzhu down and ran over to hug her leg, "Where have you been? I miss you."
"Let's go shopping." Shen Nanzhi touched her head and took out the remaining half of the popsicle from his pocket. It was half melted, and the sugar water dripped down the wrapping paper. "Do you want to eat it?"
Zhuzhu took it, took a bite of the wrapping paper, and sucked the sugar water inside, making a sizzling sound.
